title: 1970s muon scan of the central pyramid

tellings.quote: So, they they muon scanned the central pyramid back in the '70s and I have that paper in here as well

So this next thing I mentioned that there was a muon scanning of the central pyramid. Luis Alvarez, I knew I recognized the name, so he was a part of this. They scanned the Belzoni chamber and the area above the Belzoni chamber. They didn't find anything.
tellings.difference: Names Luis Alvarez and says the scan found nothing above the Belzoni chamber.
tellings.link_reason: The same muon scanning paper on the central pyramid that Jeffrey cites in the 1970s muon-scan story.

as_told.title: Alvarez muon scan of Khafre found nothing above the Belzoni chamber

plain: In the 1970s scientists scanned the central pyramid at Giza with muons, particles from space that pass through rock and can show hidden empty spaces, according to a pyramid researcher named Jeffrey Drum. He tells Michels he has the paper with him and says the physicist Luis Alvarez took part in the work. He says they scanned the Belzoni chamber, a known room inside the pyramid, and the area above it, and "didn't find anything."
